method: FFmpeg loudnorm input integrated loudness and true peak; independent fixed playback gain per prepared codec file
analyzer: ffmpeg version n7.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers
description: Static gain replaces peak normalization before catalogue gain, distance attenuation and master volume. True-peak ceiling applies after the largest catalogue gain for that file. Multi-take families share an achievable target across both codecs. No compression or audio-file changes.
